mechanism: Phenelzine inhibits monoamine oxidase increasing sympathomimetic sensitivity, while flecainide has negative inotropic and arrhythmogenic potential that may be potentiated by enhanced catecholamine effects and altered cardiac conduction.
action: Avoid combination if possible; if necessary, use with extreme caution with baseline ECG monitoring and careful dose titration of flecainide with consideration of alternative antiarrhythmics.
